title: CollabUserEngmtRecordLink - Data API
description: Represents an association between a CollabUserEngagementMetric and a Salesforce record. It tracks which Salesforce record, such as an Account or Contact, is associated with the user engagement metric. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

MetricDate.description: The date of the gathered metric.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The unique name of the CollabUserEngmtRecordLink object.

ObjectType.description: The object type of the Salesforce record, such as Account or Contact.

ParentRecordId.description: The ID of the Salesforce record.

UserEngagementMetricId.description: The ID of the CollabUserEngagementMetric record.
